summary: Radware Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 financial results press release. The filing reports revenue of $79.8 million (up 11% YoY), Cloud ARR of $98 million (up 23% YoY), non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.30, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.14. Cash and securities totaled $433.8 million; operating cash flow was $19.9 million. The results of subsidiary SkyHawk were classified as discontinued operations. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation filing.
